Evaluating p3's trade offer. CONNECTICUT_AVENUE would complete their light-blue monopoly. ILLINOIS_AVENUE blocks p2's red properties. The $100 cash is a bonus.

Completing p3's light-blue monopoly is catastrophic. They have $679 and can build houses immediately. Light blues are cheap to develop and hit frequently. I need the $100 cash for Virginia ($160) and pink houses. The $50 rent increase from Short Line is modest.

With $579 left after the $100 payment, p3 could immediately place three houses on each light-blue property. The resulting rent would be devastating midgame. I cannot counter away CONNECTICUT_AVENUE, ST_JAMES_PLACE, or PENNSYLVANIA_AVENUE. Virginia is unowned and unavailable for trade.

I cannot trade for Tennessee from p3 without giving up CONNECTICUT_AVENUE. I have no other high-value properties to offer in return.

Rejecting the offer is the right call. Counter-trades would only help p3 complete their light-blue monopoly. I am considering buying Tennessee from them to block their orange properties.
